title: 将AI引入自主系统：从认知到集体智能
summary: 本文强调自主系统是AI发展的终极阶段，提出基于通用智能体架构的设计与评估框架，涵盖认知功能、长期记忆、决策规划及多智能体协调，并探讨智能体可信度评估方法，指出当前技术与愿景间的巨大差距。
summary_en: This article highlights autonomous systems as the ultimate stage of AI development, presenting a comprehensive framework based on a generic agent architecture that composes cognitive functions around long-term memory. It addresses sensory-to-structured data linking, goal-driven decision-making and planning, multi-agent coordination, and agent trustworthiness evaluation, concluding with a critical assessment of the gap between aspirational vision and current state of the art.
